dataset_provenance.protocol_provenance: Project-defined open-set protocol constructed from the official BFW data. BFW publishes verification and bias-analysis protocols; it does not publish an open-set identification protocol, and none is implied here.

feature_definitions.gallery_size: Enrolled identities searched, which scales impostor exposure.
feature_definitions.probe_detection_confidence: YuNet detection score for the probe image.
feature_definitions.probe_face_area_ratio: Detected face box area divided by whole-image area.
feature_definitions.top1_gallery_image_count: Images that contributed to the top-ranked template.
feature_definitions.top1_similarity: Cosine similarity to the highest-ranked gallery template.
feature_definitions.top2_similarity: Cosine similarity to the second-ranked gallery template.
feature_definitions.top5_similarity_mean: Mean similarity across the five highest-ranked templates.
feature_definitions.top5_similarity_stdev: Sample standard deviation across those five similarities.

limitations: A benchmark-validated, human-review-only research proof of concept. Nothing here is production-ready, unbiased, secure, or capable of proving fraudulent behaviour.
The classifier predicts whether a search should open a human-review case. Its output is not evidence of duplication, fraud or misuse, and no sanction follows from it.
Coefficients describe association within this classifier on these benchmark identities. They are not causal, and they do not transfer to another population.
Demographic subgroup is never a classifier input. It is used only for post-hoc fairness reporting.
Extraction failures are reported separately and are never counted as genuine negative decisions.

model.serialisation: plain JSON numerics; no pickle is written or read

pipeline.comparison_scope: Complete pipeline: detection, preprocessing and embedding. A difference between pipelines cannot be attributed to the embedding model alone.
pipeline.licence_note: OpenCV Zoo release: YuNet weights MIT, SFace weights Apache-2.0. Both are redistributable for research use.

policy_note: A result above threshold opens a case for human review only. It is not evidence of scam activity and does not ban, reject or accuse any identity.
